recipes.title: 3-Ingredient Egg, Yogurt & Oat Bread Rolls

items.i: heaped tbsp Greek yogurt (or cottage cheese)

steps: Whisk the egg and Greek yogurt, then mix in the ground oats and salt. No baking powder needed.
Line two small ramekins with baking paper and divide the batter between them. Sprinkle with sesame seeds if you like.
Bake until risen, golden and set in the middle: about 12–15 minutes in the air fryer at 350°F (180°C), or 20–25 minutes in the oven.
Let them cool a little, then slice. They're soft and work with eggs, butter or anything you like.
recipes.notes: Translated from the creator's Spanish post ("I don't buy store bread anymore"). This amount makes 2 rolls. She doesn't say how she bakes them or for how long, so the time and temperature are my estimate, and so are the macros.
